info.name: MarriageHall Microservices API
info.description:
Comprehensive, production-grade Postman API testing collection for the MarriageHall Spring Boot microservices ecosystem.

All protected APIs use Bearer {{accessToken}}.

Includes complete coverage of:
- API Gateway (Port 8081)
- Auth Service (Port 9090)
- Hall Service (Port 8087)
- Booking Service & Payments (Port 8082)
- Review Service (Port 8086)
- Eureka Discovery (Port 8761)
- Config Server (Port 8888)
- Negative Tests & Business Rule Invariants

item.name: 07 - Negative Tests & Business Rules
item.description: Exhaustive error handling and security verification: 400 Validation, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict.

request.description: Sending empty body to signup must fail Bean Validation (@NotBlank, @NotNull) and return 400 Bad Request.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 400 Bad Request", function () {

request.description: Registering an email that already exists in MySQL must throw EmailAlreadyExistsException and return 409 Conflict.

exec: pm.test("Error message mentions existing email", function () {

request.description: Supplying incorrect password must fail BCrypt match and return 401 Unauthorized.

exec: pm.test("Error message reports Invalid email or password", function () {

item.name: 04 - Gateway - Missing Bearer Token on Protected API (Expect 401)

request.description: Invoking protected API without Authorization header must be blocked by Gateway JwtAuthenticationFilter with 401 Unauthorized.
Tampered or invalid signature JWT must be rejected by Gateway with 401 Unauthorized.
Customer (Role: USER) attempting to create a hall must be rejected with 403 Forbidden ('Only vendors can create halls').

exec: pm.test("Error message specifies only vendors can create halls", function () {
